parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the door of the safe, made of thick steel for security purposes. It is rectangular and attached to the main body with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: The door provides access to the interior of the safe and serves as the main barrier against unauthorized entry.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, typically locking securely when closed.

parts.name: Switch (Handle Lock)
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle or locking switch of the safe, made of steel and located on the door front.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to engage or disengage the locking mechanism, allowing the door to be opened or secured.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or turns to operate the internal locking bolts.

parts.name: Switch (Dial Knob)
parts.Basic_description: This is the combination dial or knob of the safe, made of steel and mounted on the door.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to input the combination code that unlocks the safe’s locking mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly to align internal tumblers or electronic sensors for unlocking.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the safe, made of thick steel panels forming a rigid box structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the structural integrity and protection for the contents inside the safe.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it supports all other components.
